text:
By commissioning me, you agree to these terms and assert you are >18 years old.
At the moment I only do public, feral, SFW commissions!
Characters must have an established design (e.g. refsheet, or from real-life). Real-life animals get a -20% discount.
I can feral-ify anthro characters, if you have reference for what the body shape should roughly look like.
I reserve the right to later adapt your commission as a monetized video for my YouTube channel, and/or release project files for people to learn from. Typically I’ll recolor characters to look like real-life animals as my YouTube is also for a non-furry audience, but if I want to post a video with your OC as-is I’ll make sure it’s okay with you first!

title: tfAnimator
text:
Commission process
I do 2 types of comissions: 3D sculpts and 3D tf animations. I need a sculpt before I can animate a tf.
You can skip commissioning a sculpt if you use one of the existing models listed in my assets page.
Currently, I cannot use commissioner-provided models for animations. I must make them myself.
The process goes like this:

(Optional) You DM or email me with clarifying questions.
You fill out the commission form.
I email you; we agree on all details, price, and terms upfront.
After some time, I send you WIP renders at the following stages.
Please don’t hesitate to be detailed in your revision notes! :)

3D sculpts:

Basic shape (1 revision)
Main sculpt & fur (1 revision)
Detailing, posing, rendering (1 revision)

3D tf animations:

Very rough animatic (∞ revisions, within reason)
Key posing (1 revision)
In-betweening and rendering (1 minor revision3)



After completion, you receive a full-resolution render to do with as you please.

title: tfAnimator
text:
Payment
I accept payment via PayPal or Stripe.
You can pay in 40/30/30 installments, or 100% upfront. If you require evenly-spaced invoices let me know ahead of time, otherwise I will send invoices whenever I happen to reach the appropriate stage.

Refunds
Full refunds are only available before the following breakpoints (I’ll remind you):

Sculpts: Before completing the 1st revision of the basic shape stage.
Animations: Before completing the 3rd revision of the animatic stage.

Partial refunds are available for those who paid installments early or 100% upfront. The refund is proportional to the unfinished portion of the piece, minus any payment processing fees.
I reserve the right to cancel the commission due to breach of these terms, poor communication, or inappropriate behavior on part of the commissioner. In these cases I still issue a full or partial refund as explained above. I may choose not to deal with someone who has shown themselves to be rude or deceptive.
In the unlikely event I need to cancel for my own personal reasons (my own fault or emergency), I refund in full.
